lines.en: Hey, hey, I just wanted to let you know I've changed my mind.
I'm going to do it. I'm going to kiss Joey.
No, you can't. Friends hooking up is a bad idea.
Please, what about you and Chandler?
That's different. I was drunk and stupid.
What about all the guys that you got the phone numbers from?
Why don't you just kiss one of them?
I could, I could, but I don't want to. I want to kiss Joey.
You're right. I think it's a big mistake, but it's, it's your decision.
I'm going to do it. And I can't stop you.
Hey, Rich, have you seen Charlie anywhere?
